en.question: During the Draw Phase, if I activate the effect of <<10945>> in my Graveyard and add it to my hand, can I activate a different <<10945>> this turn that was already in my hand?
en.title: During the Draw Phase, if I activate the effect of <<10945>> in my Graveyard and add it to my hand, can I activate a different <<10945>> this turn that was already in my hand?

ja.answer: ドローフェイズに「<<10945>>」の効果を発動し、墓地から手札に加えているターン、墓地から手札に加えた「<<10945>>」だけでなく、手札に持っていた別の「<<10945>>」も発動する事はできます。
